title: A Restaurant Complaint
summary: A customer politely complains about a wrong order and the waiter fixes the problem.

lines.speaker: Cliente
lines.pt: Com licença, acho que houve um engano no meu pedido.
lines.en: Excuse me, I think there was a mistake with my order.

lines.speaker: Cliente
lines.pt: Eu pedi peixe grelhado, mas recebi frango.
lines.en: I ordered grilled fish, but I received chicken.

lines.speaker: Garçom
lines.pt: O senhor tem razão. Vou verificar na cozinha agora.
lines.en: You are right. I'll check in the kitchen now.

lines.speaker: Cliente
lines.pt: Obrigado. Também pedi a salada sem cebola.
lines.en: Thank you. I also asked for the salad without onion.

lines.speaker: Garçom
lines.pt: Peço desculpas. Vamos preparar outro prato imediatamente.
lines.en: I apologize. We will prepare another dish immediately.

lines.speaker: Cliente
lines.pt: Tudo bem, eu entendo que o restaurante está cheio.
lines.en: That's okay, I understand that the restaurant is full.

lines.speaker: Garçom
lines.pt: Para compensar, a sobremesa ficará por conta da casa.
lines.en: To make up for it, dessert will be on the house.

comprehension.question: What was wrong with the salad request?
How does the restaurant compensate the customer?
